answer.reason: The verses tell of his rescue as a child, his repair of the temple and his death by conspiracy, each beyond what the summary says.

clauses.english: was hidden as a child and escaped Athaliah's slaughter of the royal sons
clauses.quote: stole him from among the king's sons which were slain

clauses.english: ordered the house of the LORD repaired
clauses.quote: Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD

clauses.english: was slain by his servants in a conspiracy
clauses.quote: his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash

doubts: 2KI 13:1, 13:10 and 14:1 mention the other Joash/Jehoash kings or only synchronise dates; 2KI 13:10, 13:12, 14:13, 14:17 and 2CH 25:23, 25:25 concern Jehoash of Israel and were left out.
1CH 3:11 only lists him in a genealogy and was left out.
